title: mcp/list_open_pairs/v2
description: The result of the list_open_pairs tool (F26-T10, R8; D-9, D-28 v3.39): every open direction of the pair/v1 record in force for each pair (a later record for the same pair supersedes; F26-T19) under targets/<id>/review/pairs/ — the two candidates, the direction, the last attempt recorded or null, its target_id, and submit_as: pair-proof, the artifact type a proof or refutation of it goes through submit_proof as — with its pair-proof template under the blind rule and how to ask for a refutation template (`n`; F26-T19, v2), in the records' order: nothing is ranked (D-25), and an open direction is work on a review, never a frontier entry (F26-Q6). Every value is an id, an enum or the gate's own attempt record, so nothing is demarcated. Or an error result naming the source that did not answer, or the filter refused (R10).

read_at.description: The commit of main the graph was read at, or the branch name when the service could not learn its head (F05-T13).

target_id.description: The target filter as given; null for every target.

direction.description: forward: a implies b; backward: b implies a.

attempt.description: The last attempt recorded while open (who, tool, budget_s), or null.

submit_as.description: The artifact type a proof or refutation of the direction is submitted as, through submit_proof.

template.description: The proof template for the direction, ready to fill: the helper region and the proof region are the contributor's, every other byte the gate's (opn_gate.pair_proofs.template). Null when withheld by the blind rule or when the direction has no proof template (template_note says why).

template_withheld.description: `blind` when the caller has no candidate on the record, so neither candidate's Lean, and so no template, is shown (F26-R3); null when shown.

template_note.description: Why the direction has no proof template (the claims' shapes differ, or a candidate cannot be read), or null.

refutation.description: Whether an instance can refute the direction (indexed claims only), how to ask for its template, and the template at the `n` asked for (null without one, or when withheld).

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
